arxiv-1804-07321.title: Search for disappearing tracks as a signature of new long-lived particles in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-1804-07321.description: Abstract A search is presented for long-lived charged particles that decay within the CMS detector and produce the signature of a disappearing track. A disappearing track is an isolated track with missing hits in the outer layers of the silicon tracker, little or no energy in associated calorimeter deposits, and no associated hits in the muon detectors.

arxiv-2205-12541.title: η \eta -glueball mixing from N f = 2 N_{f}=2 lattice QCD
arxiv-2205-12541.creator: Xiangyu Jiang, Wei Sun, Feiyu Chen, Ying Chen, Ming Gong, Zhaofeng Liu, Renqiang Zhang
arxiv-2205-12541.description: Abstract We perform the first lattice study on the mixing of the isoscalar pseudoscalar meson η \eta and the pseudoscalar glueball G G in the N f = 2 N_{f}=2 QCD at the pion mass m π ≈ 350 m_{\pi}\approx 350 MeV.

arxiv-2306-15599.title: Coupling a Recurrent Neural Network to SPAD TCSPC Systems for Real-time Fluorescence Lifetime Imaging
arxiv-2306-15599.creator: Yang Lin, Paul Mos, Andrei Ardelean, Claudio Bruschini, Edoardo Charbon
arxiv-2306-15599.description: Abstract Fluorescence lifetime imaging (FLI) has been receiving increased attention in recent years as a powerful diagnostic technique in biological and medical research. However, existing FLI systems often suffer from a tradeoff between processing speed, accuracy, and robustness. In this paper, we propose a robust approach that enables fast FLI with no degradation of accuracy.

arxiv-2404-05458.title: Teaching Higher-Order Logic Using Isabelle
arxiv-2404-05458.creator: Simon Tobias Lund Jørgen Villadsen, 2
arxiv-2404-05458.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Simon Tobias Lund Jørgen Villadsen, 2. We present a formalization of higher-order logic in the Isabelle proof assistant, building directly on the foundational framework Isabelle/Pure and developed to be as small and readable as possible. It should therefore serve as a good introduction for someone looking into learning about higher-order logic and proof assistants, without having to study the much more complex Isabelle/HOL with heavier automation.

arxiv-2404-11187.title: Transverse Inscription of Silicon Waveguides by Picosecond Laser Pulses
arxiv-2404-11187.creator: Markus Blothe*, Alessandro Alberucci, Namig Alasgarzade, Maxime Chambonneau, Stefan Nolte
arxiv-2404-11187.description: Abstract In this paper, picosecond laser inscription of segmented waveguides in crystalline silicon based on a deterministic single-pulse modification process is demonstrated. Pulses of 43 ps duration at 1.55 µm wavelength are used to transversely inscribe periodic structures with a pulse-to-pulse pitch of around 2 µm.

arxiv-2501-03166.title: Semantic Captioning: Benchmark Dataset and Graph-Aware Few-Shot In-Context Learning for SQL2Text
arxiv-2501-03166.creator: Ali Al-Lawati Jason Lucas Prasenjit Mitra
arxiv-2501-03166.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance in various NLP tasks, including semantic parsing, which translates natural language into formal code representations. However, the reverse process, translating code into natural language, termed semantic captioning , has received less attention.

arxiv-2504-04489.title: Paper BOAT Bruhat Order and Alcovic Tilings
arxiv-2504-04489.creator: Federico Castillo, Damian de la Fuente, Nicolas Libedinsky, David Plaza
arxiv-2504-04489.description: Abstract We derive a formula for computing the size of lower Bruhat intervals for elements in the dominant cone of an affine Weyl group of type A A . This enumeration problem is reduced to counting lattice points in certain polyhedra. Our main tool is a decomposition—or tiling—of each interval into smaller, combinatorially tractable pieces, which we call paper boats.

arxiv-2506-16651.title: A Distributional-Lifting Theorem for PAC Learning
arxiv-2506-16651.creator: Guy Blanc, Jane Lange, Carmen Strassle, Li-Yang Tan
arxiv-2506-16651.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Guy Blanc, Jane Lange, Carmen Strassle, Li-Yang Tan. The apparent difficulty of efficient distribution-free PAC learning has led to a large body of work on distribution-specific learning. Distributional assumptions facilitate the design of efficient algorithms but also limit their reach and relevance.

arxiv-2511-11214.title: Adverbs Revisited: Enhancing WordNet Coverage of Adverbs with a Supersense Taxonomy
arxiv-2511-11214.creator: Jooyoung Lee, Jader Martins Camboim de Sá
arxiv-2511-11214.description: Abstract WordNet offers rich supersense hierarchies for nouns and verbs, yet adverbs remain underdeveloped, lacking a systematic semantic classification. We introduce a linguistically grounded supersense typology for adverbs, empirically validated through annotation, that captures major semantic domains including manner, temporal, frequency, degree, domain, speaker-oriented, and subject-oriented functions.

pmc-10507521.title: The Development of Game-Based Digital Mental Health Interventions: Bridging the Paradigms of Health Care and Entertainment

pmc-10507521.description: Game elements are increasingly used to improve user engagement in digital mental health interventions, and specific game mechanics may yield therapeutic effects per se and thereby contribute to digital mental health intervention efficacy. pmc-10523808.title: Malaria innovation: new nets, old challenges
pmc-10523808.creator: Unknown
pmc-10523808.description: The release of the first nets using chlorfenapyr is a cause for celebration but raises questions regarding how best to leverage innovation. pmc-11604270.creator: Onur Levent Ulusoy, Sadık Server, Murat Yesilova, Nagihan İnan
pmc-11604270.description: BackgroundWhole-body positron emission tomography/magnetic resonance imaging (WB-PET/MRI) is increasingly used in the initial evaluation of oncology patients. pmc-12427197.title: The Impact of Patient, Tumor, and Socioeconomic Characteristics on Survival in Upper Urinary Tract Urothelial Carcinoma (UTUC): A Population-Based Registry Study from Hamburg, Germany (2004–2021)
pmc-12427197.creator: Annemarie Schultz, Niklas Jobst, Frederik Peters, Christopher Netsch, Clemens M. Rosenbaum, Simon Filmar
pmc-12427197.description: Simple SummaryPeople with fewer social and economic resources often have lower chances of early cancer detection and access to effective treatment. This study investigates how living conditions in different neighborhoods of Hamburg—measured using a deprivation index—affect the survival chances of patients with a cancer of the upper urinary tract.

pmc-12561512.title: Genome-Wide Thioredoxin System in Cardamine hupingshanensis: Role in Se Stress and Metabolism
pmc-12561512.creator: Yao Li, Huanqiu Xue, Yanke Lu, Zhixin Xiang, Zhi Hou, Yifeng Zhou, Qiaoyu Tang
pmc-12561512.description: Simple SummaryAs a selenium hyperaccumulator plant, the role of the thioredoxin system in Cardamine hupingshanensis in selenium stress response and selenium metabolism remains unclear. Elucidating the function of this system is of important significance for understanding the mechanisms of plant selenium tolerance and optimizing selenium biofortification in crops.

uslaw-usc-t12-s215.title: 12 U.S.C. § 215 — Consolidation of banks within same State
uslaw-usc-t12-s215.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t12-s215.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 2 (National Banks); Subchapter XVI (Consolidation And Merger). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In general Any national bank or any bank incorporated under the laws of any State may, with the approval of the Comptroller, be consolidated with one or more national banking associations located in the same State under the charter.
